tagline: Record Loom video briefs for upcoming meetings and share recaps automatically
metaTitle: Google Calendar + Loom Integration: Loom Recaps for Meetings
metaDescription: Get reminders to send a Loom brief before meetings and record a recap after. GAIA shares it with attendees. See the setup steps.
intro:
The best meetings start with shared context and end with a clear record — but most meetings do neither. Attendees arrive without reviewing relevant background, and decisions made during the call are poorly documented afterward. Loom offers a simple way to record context-setting briefs before meetings and concise recaps after them, but without automation, creating and sharing those videos requires discipline that's hard to maintain across a full calendar.

GAIA connects the two to build async context into every meeting automatically. When a meeting appears on your Google Calendar, GAIA can remind you to record a brief so attendees arrive informed. After the meeting, GAIA prompts you to record a recap and then shares the Loom link with all attendees directly, creating a searchable async record without manual distribution.

This integration is particularly valuable for distributed teams across time zones where pre-read context reduces the need for long synchronous meetings, for managers who run recurring check-ins where a brief async update could replace a full meeting, and for teams committed to async-first communication who want their calendar workflows to reflect that principle.

useCases.title: Pre-meeting Loom brief reminders
useCases.description: The day before a scheduled meeting, GAIA reminds you to record a short Loom brief with the agenda and context so attendees can prepare and the meeting itself can focus on decisions.

useCases.title: Post-meeting recap video prompts
useCases.description: Within minutes of a meeting ending, GAIA prompts you to record a brief recap summarizing decisions and next steps, while the discussion is still fresh.

useCases.title: Auto-share Loom recaps with attendees
useCases.description: Once a post-meeting video is recorded, GAIA shares the link with all attendees via email or calendar event comment so the record reaches everyone automatically.

useCases.title: Replace recurring meetings with async updates
useCases.description: For recurring Google Calendar meetings, GAIA can suggest replacing selected occurrences with a video update when the agenda doesn't require live discussion, reducing meeting load.

useCases.title: Onboarding video library from calendar events
useCases.description: GAIA tracks videos recorded for recurring training or onboarding events and organizes them into a folder so new team members can access the full video library.

howItWorks.step: Connect Google Calendar and Loom to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authenticate your Google account and your workspace in GAIA's settings. Grant GAIA calendar read access and Loom library access so it can track events and videos.

howItWorks.step: Set your meeting brief and recap preferences
howItWorks.description: Configure which calendar events should trigger brief reminders and recap prompts, how far in advance to send the reminder, and where recorded videos should be filed.

howItWorks.step: GAIA automates the async meeting loop
howItWorks.description: GAIA monitors your calendar for upcoming and completed meetings, sends reminders at the right time, and shares recorded videos with attendees automatically.

faqs.question: Can I choose which meeting types trigger Loom reminders?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can configure reminders only for external meetings, only for meetings above a certain duration, or only for events with specific keywords in the title.

faqs.question: Does GAIA share the recap link via calendar event updates or email?
faqs.answer: You can choose either method. GAIA can add the link as a comment to the calendar event, send it via email to attendees, or both.

faqs.question: What if I don't record a recap after a meeting?
faqs.answer: GAIA sends one reminder prompt and then stops. It does not send repeated reminders for the same meeting if you choose not to record.

faqs.question: Can GAIA help schedule a meeting when a recorded video needs live discussion?
faqs.answer: Yes. If a recording prompts follow-up questions requiring a live call, you can ask GAIA to find a time on the calendar and schedule a meeting with the relevant attendees.
